name: no life
source:
A game about Mumei and Alex. Mumei is sharp and witty, while Alex is more sentimental and bleak. They both play a role in the player’s life…

[From [url=https://witchfiend.itch.io/nolife]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款关于木美和亚历克斯的游戏。木眉犀利、机智，而亚历克斯则多愁善感、阴郁。他们都在玩家的生活中扮演着重要的角色……

[来自[url=https://witchfiend.itch.io/nolife]Itch.io[/url]]
